title: The angels who visited Abraham and Lot in Sodom as beautiful Nordic-like men
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of The angels who visited Abraham and Lot in Sodom as beautiful Nordic-like men, about biblical antiquity at Sodom, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And uh they they did look particularly beautiful because the one who goes to Sodom to retrieve Lot

plain: In the Bible, angels visit the patriarch Abraham and then his nephew Lot in the city of Sodom. Jason Jorjani, a researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says these angels were described as especially beautiful, pointing to the one who goes to Sodom to bring Lot out, and he links them to tall, fair, Nordic-looking men. If he is right, the old scripture would be describing visitors who looked like the Nordic beings some people now report.
